Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the use of water by public utility districts bordered by the Columbia river in pumped storage projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of water by public utility districtsbordered by the Columbia river in pumped storage projects; adding a newsection to chapter 54.16 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter to thecontrary, a public utility district bordered by the Columbia river maysupply water from a pumped storage generating facility under itscontrol to be used in a pumped storage generating facility to anyentity that sells water, directly or indirectly, to the public, andcontracts therefor must extend over the period of years and contain theterms and conditions for the sale thereof as the commission of thepublic utility district elects. Such a contract may only be madepursuant to resolution of the commission authorizing such a contract,and the resolution must be introduced at a meeting of the commission atleast ten days prior to the date of the adoption of the resolution.However, the commission shall first make adequate provision for theneeds of the public utility district, both actual and prospective.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
